current_phase.label: Public /chat route verified and product acceptance closeout

current_milestone.label: Unified-account entry, onboarding, homepage, and one real DeepSeek round-trip are live

progress_summary: This repo remains the deployment wrapper for the official LobeHub image on the local Mac. The public `/chat` route uses root-domain OIDC, LobeHub email/password login stays disabled, mounted-path custom image patches remain required, and DeepSeek remains the only provider that has been live-validated end to end. This closeout round backed up the LobeChat database/data and root edge config, fixed `/chat-s3` signed upload forwarding by preserving SigV4 query strings and overriding the upstream Host header to `rustfs:9000`, and verified both local-control and public root-edge presigned PUT uploads. A real browser root session then verified normal message sending, six-file upload (`txt`, `md`, code, `docx`, `pptx`, `xlsx`), uploaded-file reading with exact smoke markers, Word/PPT/Excel generation through `local-office-mcp`, public `/chat-files/office/*` downloads with correct OOXML MIME/zip magic, and readback of generated Office content. `local-office-mcp` is now versioned as the local DS Pro capability baseline: it can create/read Word, PowerPoint, Excel, read text/code/Markdown and `/chat-s3` uploaded files, run OCR through host Tesseract plus Chinese language data, and locally import LobeHub market skills without Cloud Sandbox authorization. Existing DeepSeek assistants no longer contain `lobe-cloud-sandbox`; they include `lobe-agent-documents`, `local-office-mcp`, `openclaw-skills-office-mcp`, `lobe-skill-store`, and the locally installed `bytedance-deer-flow-find-skills` skill. The built-in `lobe-skill-store` search path was verified in chat, and the local `import_market_skill` path was added to avoid empty responses from built-in duplicate imports. Failed/truncated test topics created during this round were deleted while retaining successful acceptance topics. Release health, search/crawl health, upload proxy tests, Office/OCR tests, and recent log scans are clean for the targeted error classes.
blockers: Non-DeepSeek provider keys in `deploy/.env` remain placeholders, so Anthropic/OpenAI/Google model validation is still intentionally out of scope for this round.

The live app still emits low-priority asset noise such as missing `favicon-progress.ico` variants, but this does not block auth, onboarding, homepage delivery, search, crawl, or the validated DeepSeek chat path.

Official LobeHub Market cloud-skill authorization is still intentionally not part of the baseline until this domain has valid `MARKET_TRUSTED_CLIENT_ID` and `MARKET_TRUSTED_CLIENT_SECRET` credentials registered with redirect `https://hernando-zhao.cn/market-auth-callback`; local Office/file/skill workflows must not depend on that path.
next_step: Keep `/chat` acceptance tied to real browser runs and log scans. If future third-party market skills genuinely require external cloud execution, mark them explicitly as externally authorized instead of routing internal Office/file/skill workflows through Cloud Sandbox.
